SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.record_path
FROM product_variants pv
JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id
JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp1.property_value_text = '12 V'
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'battery platform' AND pvp2.property_value_text = '12v-system'
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp3 ON pv.product_sku = pvp3.product_sku AND pvp3.property_key = 'kit contents' AND pvp3.property_value_text = 'two battery kit'
WHERE pk.product_kind_name = 'Cordless Drill Driver'
  AND pf.product_family_name = 'Festool Brushless SYS 1XD-LGR Cordless Drill Driver'
  AND pv.brand = 'Festool';
